info.title: Radius_Server
info.description: RESTful interface for AOS-CX switch software

accounting_statistics.description: Contains statistical information relating to accounting packets exchanged with the server.

bad_authenticator.description: Number of Accounting-Response packets received from this server with invalid authenticator information.

dropped_pkts.description: Number of Accounting packets from this server that have been dropped by the switch.

malformed_responses.description: Number of malformed response packets received from this server.

pending_requests.description: Number of accounting requests that the server has not yet responded back to. This does not include requests that have been timed out.

requests.description: Number of accounting requests sent to this server (excluding retransmissions).

responses.description: Number of accounting responses received from this server.

retransmits.description: Number of accounting requests re-transmitted to this server.

round_trip_time.description: Time interval in seconds between the most recent accounting-request sent to this server and the corresponding response received from the server.

timed_out_requests.description: Number of accounting requests to this server that have been timed out.

unknown_type.description: Number of packets of unknown type received from  this server.

accounting_udp_port.description: UDP port to be used for the communication to RADIUS accounting.

address.description:
Reference Resource: [Radius_Server](#/Radius_Server)
IPV4/IPV6 address or FQDN of the RADIUS server.

auth_statistics.description: Contains key-value pairs that report the number of authentication packets communicated with the server. These statistics  will be updated every 5 seconds.

access_accepts.description: Number of RADIUS Access-Accept packets received from this server.

access_challenge.description: Number of RADIUS Access-challenge packets reveived from this server.

access_rejects.description: Number of RADIUS Access-Reject packets received from this server.

access_request.description: Number of RADIUS Access-Request packets sent to this server (excluding retransmissions).

access_response_malformed.description: Number of malformed RADIUS Access-Response packets received from this server.

access_retransmits.description: Number of RADIUS Access-Request retransmitted from this server.

bad_authenticator.description: Number of RADIUS Access-Response Packets containing invalid authenticators or signature attributes received from this server.

dropped_pkt.description: Number of RADIUS packets dropped from this server on the authentication port.

malformed_pkt.description: Number of malformed authentication packets received from this server.

pending_requests.description: Number of RADIUS Access-Request packets destined for this server that have not yet timed out or received a response.

round_trip_time.description: Time interval between the most recent Access-Reply/ Access-Challenge and the Access-Request that matched it from this server.

timeout.description: Number of timed out RADIUS Access-Request packets destined for this server.

unknown_types.description: Number of RADIUS packets of unknown type received from this server on the authentication port.

auth_type.description: Specifies the server specific authentication method (pap/chap) to be used. If not set, the globally configured authentication method (pap/chap) will be used.

password.description: Password to be used for authentication.

user_id.description: User name to be used for authentication.

ipsec_ah.description: IPSec Authentication Header configuration. If both AH and ESP are configured, then ESP will be ignored and AH will be used. If both System level and Radius_Server AH configuration is provided then Radius_Server configuration will be used for the specific Radius server.

SPI.description: Security Parameters Index (SPI) for the Security Association (SA). AH SPI must be unique on a router because it is carried in IPsec protocol packet to enable the receiving system to select the SA to process the packet.

ah_null.description: Disables AH configuration for the Radius server.

ipsec_esp.description: IPSec Encapsulating Security Protocol configuration. If both AH and ESP are configured, then ESP will be ignored and AH will be used. If both System level and Radius_Server ESP configuration is provided then Radius_Server configuration will be used for the specific Radius server.

SPI.description: Security Parameters Index (SPI) for the Security Association (SA). ESP SPI must be unique on a router because it is carried in IPsec protocol packet to enable the receiving system to select the SA to process the packet.

esp_null.description: Disables ESP configuration for the Radius server.

last_tracking_attempted_time.description: Time in seconds since Epoch when the most recent reachability tracking request was sent to the RADIUS server.

last_tracking_status_changed_time.description: Time in seconds since Epoch when RADIUS Server status last changed from reachable to unreachable or vice versa.

last_tracking_status_refreshed_time.description: Time in seconds since Epoch when the tracking status was last refreshed.

msg_authenticator_check.description: Specifies whether Message-Authenticator attribute must be presented in Radius Server Responses.

passkey.description: Specifies the passkey between RADIUS client and RADIUS server for authentication. If not set, the globally configured passkey will be used.

port.description:
Reference Resource: [Radius_Server](#/Radius_Server)
Specifies the port number for authentication.

port_access.description: Configures the message type sent in RadSec sessions created for port-access authentication for keeping the session active 'status-server' : status-server messages are sent for keeping the session active. 'keep-alive'    : keep-alive messages are be sent for keeping the session active

port_type.description:
Reference Resource: [Radius_Server](#/Radius_Server)
Specifies the type of port (tcp/udp) for authentication.

reachability_status.description: Specifies the reachability of Configured RADIUS Server. 'reachable':              tracking for this server is enabled and                           the server is reachable. 'unreachable':            tracking for this server is enabled and                           the server is not reachable. 'reachability_unhealthy': tracking for this server is enabled and                           the server is momentarily down in                           between tracking interval. An empty value means the reachability of this server is unknown.

resolved_ip_address.description: IP address resolved for this server. It can be IPv4 or IPv6. This is only set if the configured RADIUS server address is in FQDN format.

retries.description: Specifies the server specific number of retries to the RADIUS server if there is no response. If not set, the globally configured retries will be used.

server_group.description:
Reference Resource: [AAA_Server_Group](#/AAA_Server_Group)
Key specifies the RADIUS server-group that it belongs to. It would belong to a family group 'radius' group and the user defined AAA server group Value specifies the priority of the RADIUS server in the associated AAA server group. A server with lower priority in a server group is reached out first. Servers with equal priority in a group will be reached out as follows: Those belonging to VRF where vrf_name appears alphabetically earlier than the others are reached out first. If that's a tie, servers with address appearing alphabetically earlier than the others is reached out first. If that too is a tie, servers with smaller UDP port are reached out first.

status_server_port_access_statistics.description: Contains key-value pairs that report the number of RadSec status-server-request-reponse packets communicated in the RadSec session used for port-access authentication. These will be updated every 5 seconds.

status_server_requests.description: Number of status server request packets sent in RadSec session used for port-access authentication (excluding retransmissions).

status_server_responses.description: Number of status server response packets received in RadSec session used for port-access authentication.

status_server_tracking_statistics.description: Contains key-value pairs that report the number of RadSec status-server-request-reponse packets communicated in the RadSec session used for server tracking. These will be updated every 5 seconds.

status_server_requests.description: Number of status server request packets sent in RadSec session used for server tracking (excluding retransmissions).

status_server_responses.description: Number of status server response packets received in RadSec session used for server tracking.

timeout.description: Specifies the server specific timeout between authentication requests to the RADIUS server. If not set, the globally configured timeout will be used.

tls_connection_status.description: Status of the TLS connection 'tls_connection_established': RADIUS server TLS connection                               successfully established. 'tls_connection_closed':      RADIUS server TLS connection has                               been closed. 'tcp_connection_failed':      RADIUS server TCP connection could                               not be established. 'tls_connection_failed':      RADIUS server TLS connection could                               not be established. 'tcp_connection_in_progress': RADIUS server TCP connection is in                               progress. 'tls_connection_in_progress': RADIUS server TLS connection is in                               progress.

tls_initial_connection_timeout.description: RADIUS over TLS initial connection timeout value in seconds. If not specified, the globally configured initial connection timeout value will be used.

tracking_enable.description: Specifies whether tracking should be enabled on this server.

tracking_method.description: Configures the tracking method used for tracking server reacchability. Tracking method configuration is applicable only when tracking is enabled for the server. 'status-server'  : status-server messages are sent for server tracking. 'keep-alive'     : keep-alive messages are sent for server tracking. 'access-request' : access-request messages are sent for server tracking

tracking_mode.description: Specifies the tracking mode to be set for this server and is only applicable when tracking is enabled for this server. 'any'       : Server reachability is monitored regardless of               whether the server was responsive or non-responsive               to prior RADIUS client requests. 'dead-only' : Server reachability is monitored only if it is               deemed dead (based on non-responsiveness for RADIUS               client requests sent to this server earlier).

tracking_statistics.description: Contains key-value pairs that report the number of RADIUS Access-Request-Response packets communicated with the server for tracking purpose. These will be updated every 5 seconds

access_requests.description: Number of RADIUS Access-Request packets sent to this server for tracking(excluding retransmissions).

access_responses.description: Number of RADIUS Access-Response packets received for tracking packets from this server.

IPV4/IPV6 address or FQDN of the RADIUS server.

parameters.name: Radius_Server.port
parameters.description:
Reference Resource: [Radius_Server](#/Radius_Server)
Specifies the port number for authentication.

parameters.name: Radius_Server.port_type
parameters.description:
Reference Resource: [Radius_Server](#/Radius_Server)
Specifies the type of port (tcp/udp) for authentication.

accounting_udp_port.description: UDP port to be used for the communication to RADIUS accounting.

auth_type.description: Specifies the server specific authentication method (pap/chap) to be used. If not set, the globally configured authentication method (pap/chap) will be used.

password.description: Password to be used for authentication.

user_id.description: User name to be used for authentication.

ipsec_ah.description: IPSec Authentication Header configuration. If both AH and ESP are configured, then ESP will be ignored and AH will be used. If both System level and Radius_Server AH configuration is provided then Radius_Server configuration will be used for the specific Radius server.

SPI.description: Security Parameters Index (SPI) for the Security Association (SA). AH SPI must be unique on a router because it is carried in IPsec protocol packet to enable the receiving system to select the SA to process the packet.

ah_null.description: Disables AH configuration for the Radius server.

ipsec_esp.description: IPSec Encapsulating Security Protocol configuration. If both AH and ESP are configured, then ESP will be ignored and AH will be used. If both System level and Radius_Server ESP configuration is provided then Radius_Server configuration will be used for the specific Radius server.

SPI.description: Security Parameters Index (SPI) for the Security Association (SA). ESP SPI must be unique on a router because it is carried in IPsec protocol packet to enable the receiving system to select the SA to process the packet.

esp_null.description: Disables ESP configuration for the Radius server.

msg_authenticator_check.description: Specifies whether Message-Authenticator attribute must be presented in Radius Server Responses.

passkey.description: Specifies the passkey between RADIUS client and RADIUS server for authentication. If not set, the globally configured passkey will be used.

port_access.description: Configures the message type sent in RadSec sessions created for port-access authentication for keeping the session active 'status-server' : status-server messages are sent for keeping the session active. 'keep-alive'    : keep-alive messages are be sent for keeping the session active

retries.description: Specifies the server specific number of retries to the RADIUS server if there is no response. If not set, the globally configured retries will be used.

server_group.description:
Reference Resource: [AAA_Server_Group](#/AAA_Server_Group)
Key specifies the RADIUS server-group that it belongs to. It would belong to a family group 'radius' group and the user defined AAA server group Value specifies the priority of the RADIUS server in the associated AAA server group. A server with lower priority in a server group is reached out first. Servers with equal priority in a group will be reached out as follows: Those belonging to VRF where vrf_name appears alphabetically earlier than the others are reached out first. If that's a tie, servers with address appearing alphabetically earlier than the others is reached out first. If that too is a tie, servers with smaller UDP port are reached out first.

timeout.description: Specifies the server specific timeout between authentication requests to the RADIUS server. If not set, the globally configured timeout will be used.

tls_initial_connection_timeout.description: RADIUS over TLS initial connection timeout value in seconds. If not specified, the globally configured initial connection timeout value will be used.

tracking_enable.description: Specifies whether tracking should be enabled on this server.

tracking_method.description: Configures the tracking method used for tracking server reacchability. Tracking method configuration is applicable only when tracking is enabled for the server. 'status-server'  : status-server messages are sent for server tracking. 'keep-alive'     : keep-alive messages are sent for server tracking. 'access-request' : access-request messages are sent for server tracking

tracking_mode.description: Specifies the tracking mode to be set for this server and is only applicable when tracking is enabled for this server. 'any'       : Server reachability is monitored regardless of               whether the server was responsive or non-responsive               to prior RADIUS client requests. 'dead-only' : Server reachability is monitored only if it is               deemed dead (based on non-responsiveness for RADIUS               client requests sent to this server earlier).
